# Ledger & Security Requirements Checklist: B1 — Tenancy & Ledger Core

**Purpose**: Founder pre-implementation review of B1 requirements for tenant isolation, exact append-only accounting, permissions, idempotency, concurrency, reversals, and batch boundaries
**Created**: 2026-10-12
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [plan.md](../plan.md) · [contracts/](../contracts/)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Defaults applied from feature context: depth = formal pre-implementation gate; audience = Abdullrahman as founder reviewer with Codex review on the PR; focus = tenant/security boundaries and ledger correctness/concurrency.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are all B1-created tables, their tenant ownership, and their relationships enumerated without introducing B2+ entities? [Completeness, Spec §Key Entities, Data Model]
- [x] CHK002 Are the exact fields and validation rules for tenant status, lock date, settings, plan, slug, and attribution documented? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Data Model §Tenant]
- [x] CHK003 Are all membership roles, active-state semantics, uniqueness rules, and last-active-owner protection specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002–FR-003/FR-024]
- [x] CHK004 Is the complete Section 7.1 chart seed defined, including hierarchy, account type, normal side, header status, and every required `system_key`? [Completeness, Spec §FR-007–FR-009, Plan]
- [x] CHK005 Are every journal header, line, dimension, attribution, request, and reversal-link requirement specified? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010–FR-013, Data Model]
- [x] CHK006 Are the counter, idempotency, audit, and typed Vault-reference data requirements complete enough to derive objective schema constraints? [Completeness, Spec §FR-017–FR-019/FR-025–FR-026]
- [x] CHK007 Are the exact browser-callable operations distinguished from internal-only financial primitives and test-only helpers? [Completeness, Spec §FR-014–FR-015/FR-022, Contract database-security]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK008 Is the root `tenants` identity exception to child-table `tenant_id` wording explicit and non-contradictory with Rule 10? [Clarity, Plan §Constitution Check, Research R3]
- [x] CHK009 Is “suspended tenants are read-only” defined for every B1 read/write path, including internal posting and owner management? [Clarity, Spec §FR-005]
- [x] CHK010 Is the B1/B2 bootstrap boundary unambiguous: tenant, owner membership, and chart now; cash/expense/plan defaults in B2? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications/FR-006]
- [x] CHK011 Is the exact definition of a valid line unambiguous for zero, negative, both-positive, signed-64-bit bounds, inactive/header accounts, and tenant mismatch? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011–FR-012]
- [x] CHK012 Is “gapless” scoped precisely by tenant, document type, year, committed transactions, rollback, and concurrency? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, Research R9]
- [x] CHK013 Is an “identical retry” distinguished from request-id reuse by a clearly defined operation and canonical payload fingerprint? [Clarity, Spec §FR-018–FR-020, Research R8]
- [x] CHK014 Is the internal reversal primitive clearly separated from future full document reversal and denied to browser roles? [Clarity, Spec §Clarifications/FR-021–FR-023]
- [x] CHK015 Are “secret reference,” “secret value,” and permitted audit/reference metadata distinguished consistently? [Clarity, Spec §FR-026, Data Model §Tenant Secret Reference]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK016 Do the spec, plan, data model, and contracts consistently use integer `bigint` piasters and decimal-string financial JSON without a `number` boundary? [Consistency, Spec §FR-030, Contract ledger-posting]
- [x] CHK017 Does the required posting order match Rule 7 everywhere, with stock explicitly absent rather than silently skipped in B1? [Consistency, Spec §FR-014, Plan §Implementation Phases]
- [x] CHK018 Are period-lock rules consistent between normal posting, reversal, lock-date updates, and concurrent tenant-row locking? [Consistency, Spec §FR-016/FR-022, Research R10–R11]
- [x] CHK019 Are append-only requirements consistent with the narrowly permitted `reversed_by_entry_id` link transition and immutable journal lines? [Consistency, Spec §FR-013/FR-021, Research R7]
- [x] CHK020 Does account seeding by `system_key` remain consistent with codes being display identifiers only? [Consistency, Spec §FR-007–FR-009, Research R5]
- [x] CHK021 Are B1 reconciliation claims consistently limited to journal balance/reversal net zero while full T17 remains deferred to B3? [Consistency, Spec §FR-032/SC-009, Quality Gates]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK022 Can every success criterion be measured with an exact count, equality, denial result, or zero-residual condition? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001–SC-010]
- [x] CHK023 Are T16 and progressive T19 acceptance obligations mapped to every B1 table and browser-callable RPC rather than described generically? [Traceability, Spec §FR-029, Contract database-security]
- [x] CHK024 Are exact accepted and rejected piaster vectors documented, including a value above JavaScript’s safe-integer limit? [Measurability, Contract ledger-posting §Exact B1 vectors]
- [x] CHK025 Are type-generation, reset-from-zero, local database, CI, and reconciliation completion signals each defined with one objective pass condition? [Measurability, Contract quality-gates]

## Scenario & Edge-Case Coverage

- [x] CHK026 Are bootstrap success, duplicate/retry, transaction failure, conflicting slug, and partial-seed rollback scenarios covered? [Coverage, Spec §US1/Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK027 Are same-tenant, non-member, inactive-member, cross-tenant, spoofed-tenant, and suspended-tenant scenarios required for every applicable B1 surface? [Coverage, Spec §FR-004/FR-029]
- [x] CHK028 Are line-count, imbalance, invalid side, wrong account state, mixed tenant, overflow, and direct mutation failure scenarios all defined? [Coverage, Spec §US2/Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK029 Are identical retry, mismatched retry, concurrent identical request, concurrent distinct request, failure rollback, and new-year counter races addressed? [Coverage, Spec §US3/Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK030 Are locked date, already reversed, reversal-of-reversal, concurrent reversal, empty reason, unauthorized role, and idempotent reversal scenarios addressed? [Coverage, Spec §US4/Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK031 Are missing/stale/cross-tenant Vault references and every potential secret-disclosure channel explicitly addressed? [Coverage, Spec §US5/Edge Cases]

## Security, Dependencies & Batch Boundaries

- [x] CHK032 Are fixed `search_path`, explicit qualification, default-execute revocation, minimal grants, and security-definer ownership requirements complete? [Security, Spec §FR-027, Contract database-security]
- [x] CHK033 Is the audit requirement complete without making `audit_log` a second financial source of truth or allowing secret values? [Security/Consistency, Spec §FR-025–FR-026]
- [x] CHK034 Are local Docker/database-only startup, disk, clean reset, and no-CI-only-fallback dependencies documented as hard B1 gates? [Dependency, Spec §Assumptions/SC-009, Quickstart]
- [x] CHK035 Are all B2+ tables/flows, production manual journals, reports, and document/subledger reconciliation explicitly excluded from B1? [Scope, Spec §FR-015/FR-031–FR-032/SC-010]
- [x] CHK036 Is the future-FK strategy for B1 dimension UUID placeholders clear without authorizing edits to the applied migration? [Dependency, Data Model §Account/Journal Line, Research R5]
- [x] CHK037 Are generated database types required after the migration while explicitly rejecting generated `number` mappings as proof of safe financial transport? [Security/Consistency, Spec §FR-030, Quality Gates]
